title: Polynomial bit generation
statement: For all natural numbers $C$ and $e$, there is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet that, on every Boolean input $x$, halts with output the binary digit list of $C(|x|+1)^e$ after $(7C+5e+11)(|x|+1)^e$ steps.
